description: Retrieve full details of a specific clinical trial by its NCT identifier (e.g. "NCT04368728"). Returns title, official title, status, sponsor, conditions, interventions, design info, enrollment, eligibility criteria (age/sex/health volunteer), primary and secondary outcomes, brief summary, and up to 10 study locations. Source: ClinicalTrials.gov v2 API (NIH, public domain).

nct_id.description: ClinicalTrials.gov registry identifier in NCT format (e.g. "NCT04368728", "NCT01454700"). Must start with "NCT" followed by 8 digits.

name: clinicaltrials.trials.detail

error.description: Present only when the call failed. Includes error code, message, request_id, and any provider-specific extras.

result.description: Tool response payload. Shape varies per tool — consult the tool description and inputSchema. May be an object, array, string, or number depending on the upstream provider response.

title: ClinicalTrials Study Detail
